welcomeBody:
## Start with a thought

This is your local knowledge space. Create documents, organize libraries, or import Markdown and Word files.

> Every idea worth keeping deserves a place of its own.

## Give knowledge room to grow

- Everything stays on this device
- Star important documents
- Export a full backup regularly

Write your first thought.
updateFailed: Update check or installation failed. Try again later.
saveFirst: Save failed. Edits are retained. Retry or export before closing.
liveHint: Edit formatted text directly · Type ## and a space for a heading · Ctrl+B bold · Ctrl+Z undo
sourceHint: Edit original Markdown · Ctrl+Z to undo
sourcePreserved: This document uses syntax not yet supported by live editing. Source mode preserves the original content.
linkHint: Set a link for the selected text. External links do not open automatically.
editorLimit: The document has reached its maximum length. This input was not saved.
historyHint: Up to 20 automatic checkpoints, one per minute, capped at 20 MB per note. Restoring preserves your current content. Permanently deleting a note also removes its history.
historyEmpty: No history yet. Editing and saving creates a checkpoint.
recentHint: Pick up where you left off
markdownFolderHint: Import Markdown and referenced local PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP images from the selected folder. Missing images stop the import; files outside this folder are never read.
longDocumentSource: Long documents use source mode to reduce editing latency. All content is preserved when editing and exporting.
textEncoding: Unrecognized text encoding. Save as UTF-8 or UTF-16 with a BOM in your original editor, then retry.
relativeImageError: An image is missing, unsupported or outside the selected folder. Check Markdown image paths and import the folder again.
exportFilesHint: Choose a folder for separate Markdown files. Existing files are never overwritten.
shareHint: Create an offline HTML file with selected notes and local images. Nothing is uploaded.
localOnly: Your content stays local. No account required.
deleteConfirmHint: Selected notes will move to Trash and can be restored.
deleteLibraryConfirm: Deleting this empty library cannot be undone.
autoUpdateHint: Check 10 seconds after startup and every 6 hours. Failures stay quiet.
updateProgressHint: Your notes are saved before installation. The app will restart after updating.
imageOptionsHint: Change display width without changing the original image. Export retains standard Markdown image syntax.
imageFileOnly: Only local PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF images are supported.
replaceLimit: Rich editing replaces up to 5,000 matches at once. Narrow your search or switch to source mode for larger replacements.
recoveryHint: Review and restore drafts as new copies. Original notes stay unchanged. Deferred drafts remain available on the next launch.
discardDraftsHint: Discarded drafts cannot be recovered again. Saved notes will not be deleted.
draftProtectionError: Draft protection is unavailable. Unsaved text is still in this window. Retry saving or export a backup before closing.
draftPending: Latest draft is still being written; keep the app open
pdfPrintClosed: Print dialog closed. Please confirm that your PDF was saved.
aiDesktop: AI is available in the Windows app.
aiPrivacy: Off by default. Authorize sending once when configuring the key. Future messages send your chosen note text, instructions and conversation context directly to the provider, without an Orvia server.
aiModelHint: Use a text model ID that supports function calling. Test the connection to load model IDs.
aiKeyHint: Keys are stored in Windows Credential Manager, excluded from notes, backups and logs. The field clears after saving.
aiKeyMissing: Save a key for this provider in settings first.
aiConnectHint: Requests only model metadata, with no notes or generated content.
aiCost: Your provider bills API usage. Tasks stop after 180 seconds, without automatic retries. Sent requests may still be billed after cancellation.
aiSetup: Enable and configure a provider, model and key in Settings → AI and models first.
aiScope: Only the current note title and Markdown text are in scope. Image files are excluded. Each send also requires native authorization.
aiEncrypted: Encrypted vault: authorized text is decrypted before it is sent to the provider.
aiConsent: I consent to sending this note text to the selected provider
aiPromptHint: Ask about this note, or request a rewrite that preserves all facts.
aiSession: Follow-ups include reviewed recent conversation context. Chats are saved in this local space and encrypted with a private vault.
aiApplyConfirm: This saves the changes and preserves the previous version in history. Check AI-generated content for errors first.
aiApplied: AI changes saved. The original is available in document history.
aiConflict: The note changed, was deleted or locked. New content was not overwritten. Close the panel and try again.
aiError: The AI request did not complete. Check your configuration and try again.
aiAuthError: Invalid key, insufficient permissions or access denied by the provider.
aiNetworkError: Connection failed or timed out. No automatic retry was made.
aiLimitError: An input, output or round limit was reached. Shorten the note/instruction or adjust limits. Truncated output cannot be applied.
aiModelError: Model unavailable or incompatible with this API/request. Select a text model supporting function calling.
aiStoreError: Windows Credential Manager is unavailable. The key was not saved as plaintext.
aiRateError: Provider rate limit or insufficient quota. Check your account and retry manually later.
aiToolError: The model requested an unauthorized operation or returned an invalid proposal. It was rejected.
aiImageError: The proposal changed local image references. Applying it was blocked to protect images and scope.
aiCancelled: Stopped or cancelled. No changes were automatically saved.
aiBusy: An AI task is already running. Stop it or wait for completion.
aiKeyFormat: Invalid key format. Paste the complete key without spaces or line breaks.
aiChatDeleteHint: Delete this local conversation without deleting the note.
aiChatLocal: Conversations are saved only in this local space.
aiChatPrivate: Conversations are encrypted with this vault.
aiPolishPrompt: Polish this text while preserving its meaning.
aiExpandPrompt: Expand this text while preserving its meaning and tone.
aiSummarizePrompt: Summarize the key points of this text.
aiTranslatePrompt: Translate this text into English, preserving Markdown.
aiContextHint: Sends include the chosen note scope and recent conversation context. Authorize once when setting up your key; subsequent messages send directly. Removing a selection does not attach the full note.
aiHistoryTrim: Only the recent messages fitting the input limit are included; older messages are not sent.
aiChatPlaceholder: Ask a question or describe your changes…
aiFollowupPrompt: Make it more concise while keeping the key points.
aiChatWelcomeHint: Understand a passage, organize an idea, or make your writing clearer.
aiSourceRequired: This content cannot be inserted losslessly in visual mode. Switch to Markdown source and try again.
aiHistoryLimit: Chat storage limit reached (40 conversations, 80 messages each, 4 MiB total). Remove old chats or start a new conversation.
aiContextNone: No new note content is attached; only your instruction and conversation context are sent.
motionHint: Controls page transitions, UI feedback and AI waiting animations.
aiAuthorizationHint: Confirm sending permission once when saving or changing a key. Future sends go directly to the provider, including your chosen note text and conversation context. Unlocked encrypted notes are sent as decrypted text.
aiAuthorized: Authorized. Future messages do not require individual confirmation.
aiAuthorizationRequired: Authorize sending once in Settings → AI and models. You do not need to re-enter the saved key.
aiRevokeHint: Stops the active request and blocks future chat until reauthorized. Keeps the key. Sent data and charges cannot be recalled.
aiSendHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
aiDraftWhileWaiting: Draft your next message while waiting
aiStoppedHint: Generation stopped. Existing messages are kept.
aiBrainstormPrompt: Ask me about my topic, audience and purpose, then help me explore writing ideas.
aiOutlinePrompt: Ask me what I want to write about, then help me plan a clear outline.
